title: Right Kan extensions of space-valued presheaves by mapping spaces
statement:
Use universes, nerves, quasicategories, coherent functors and right-pinched mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the category $\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ of $\mathcal V$-small spaces of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. Let $u:A\to J$ be a functor between $\mathcal V$-small ordinary categories. Set $\mathcal P_A=\operatorname{Fun}(N(A)^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$ and $\mathcal P_J=\operatorname{Fun}(N(J)^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})$, formed in a containing universe. For $j\in J$ let $h_j$ be the discrete representable presheaf $h_j(k)=\operatorname{Hom}_J(k,j)$, with arrows acting by precomposition. Restriction $u^*:\mathcal P_J\to\mathcal P_A$ has a coherent right adjoint $u_*$ with, for every $P\in\mathcal P_J$ and $Q\in\mathcal P_A$, natural equivalences of whole mapping spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_J}(P,u_*Q)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_A}(u^*P,Q),\qquad (u_*Q)(j)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_A}(u^*h_j,Q).$$
Under the second equivalence, the counit component $(u_*Q)(u(a))\to Q(a)$ is evaluation of a coherent transformation $u^*h_{u(a)}\to Q$ at $1_{u(a)}\in h_{u(a)}(u(a))$. For $f:j\to j'$, the presheaf transition from the value at $j'$ to the value at $j$ is precomposition by $u^*h_j\to u^*h_{j'}$, induced by postcomposition with $f$. All displayed identifications are coherent in $P,Q,j$.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, printed pp.291-292, specialized to ordinary nerves; Yoneda evaluation identifies its counit and transitions. Read online July 30, 2026 revision. This is a space-valued RIGHT adjoint, not the arbitrary-target left Kan theorem. Archival copy WANTED; no Stacks tag states this quasicategorical assertion.

proof.text: Put $K=N(J)^{\mathrm{op}}$ and $L=N(A)^{\mathrm{op}}$. The discrete functor $W:N(J)\times L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ is $W(j,a)=\operatorname{Hom}_J(u(a),j)$, with postcomposition in $j$ and precomposition in $a$. These actions commute by associativity in $J$. Write $W_j=W(j,-)=u^*h_j$. Construct $RQ(j)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_A}(W_j,Q)$. The local-smallness clause of [lem-coef-spatial-mapping-interchange] gives $\mathcal V$-small Kan models for these values; coherent precomposition and postcomposition from [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality] assemble them into $R:\mathcal P_A\to\mathcal P_J$. Functor categories are formed in a containing universe throughout.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text:
Set $T(j,a)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}}(P(j),Q(a))$, a coherent functor on $N(J)\times L$. Apply [lem-coef-spatial-mapping-interchange] to $F=P:K\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$, $Q:L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$ and $W:K^{\mathrm{op}}\times L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$. It yields
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_J}(P,RQ)\simeq\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(N(J)\times L,\mathcal S_{\mathcal V})}(W,T).$$
The map is coherent evaluation/transposition: $\alpha$ gives $\tau$ with $\tau_{j,a}(f)(x)=\alpha_j(x)_a(f)$, on all mapping-space parameters.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text: Write $\widetilde W(j,a)=\operatorname{Map}_{N(J)}(u(a),j)$ for the coherent corepresentable weight obtained from the concrete Hom pairing. The joint comparison of [lem-coef-ordinary-nerve-discrete-hom-comparison], restricted in its first variable along $u^{\mathrm{op}}:A^{\mathrm{op}}\to J^{\mathrm{op}}$, gives $\widetilde W\simeq W$ as functors on $N(J)\times L$ and matches the identity points. Coherent Hom precomposition of [lem-coef-infinity-hom-bifunctor-functoriality] therefore identifies $\operatorname{Map}(W,T)$ with $\operatorname{Map}(\widetilde W,T)$, on the whole spaces. In particular this comparison holds coherently as $a$ varies; discreteness of individual right-pinched mapping spaces alone would not suffice.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-coef-parametric-discrete-yoneda] with $C=N(J)$, $L=N(A)^{\mathrm{op}}$, $c=N(u):L^{\mathrm{op}}=N(A)\to N(J)$ and the arbitrary-bifunctor input $T(j,a)=\operatorname{Map}(P(j),Q(a))$. Its weight is precisely $\widetilde W$, so Steps 2 and 3 identify the original mapping space with
$$\lim_{(a\to b)\in\operatorname{Tw}(L)} T(u(a),b)=\lim_{(a\to b)\in\operatorname{Tw}(L)}\operatorname{Map}(P(u(a)),Q(b)).$$
Here $a$ varies contravariantly and $b$ covariantly. For $r:a\to a'$ in $A$, $W(-,a')\to W(-,a)$ is precomposition by $u(r)$; precomposing transformations agrees under Yoneda with precomposing maps out of $P(u(a))$ by $P(u(r)):P(u(a'))\to P(u(a))$. The cited end-Yoneda theorem includes the whole twisted-arrow diagram and inverse homotopies, rather than fixed-object evaluation only. The indexing category is $\mathcal V$-small, since its simplices are finite strings in the small nerve $L$.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text: The mapping-space formula of [lem-coef-coherent-end-twisted-arrow-formula], applied to $u^*P,Q:L\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal V}$, identifies the end in Step 4 with $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_A}(u^*P,Q)$. Combining it with Steps 2-4 gives the required equivalence of whole mapping spaces, coherently in $P,Q$. Its projection at $1_a$, followed by the identity-point comparison in Step 3 and end-Yoneda evaluation in Step 4, is $\beta_a=\tau_{u(a),a}(1_{u(a)})$. The inverse formula of [lem-coef-parametric-discrete-yoneda] becomes $\tau_{j,a}(f)=\beta_a\circ P(f)$ for $f:u(a)\to j$, because $T(f,1_a)$ is Hom precomposition by $P(f)$. The end-Yoneda inverse homotopies and the coherent-end evaluation compatibility ensure that these are inverse maps of entire spaces, including all higher parameter simplices.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text: Let $\epsilon_Q:u^*RQ\to Q$ be the image of $1_{RQ}$ under the mapping-space equivalence just constructed. The evaluation formulas in Steps 2 and 5 give its component $RQ(u(a))\to Q(a)$ as evaluation at $1_{u(a)}$ of a transformation $W_{u(a)}\to Q$. Naturality in $P$ gives, for every $\alpha:P\to RQ$, exactly $\alpha\mapsto\epsilon_Q\circ u^*\alpha$, including all mapping-space parameters. Thus this $R$ is a coherent right adjoint to $u^*$, with the stated counit; set $u_*=R$. Its value $RQ(j)=\operatorname{Map}_{\mathcal P_A}(u^*h_j,Q)$ is the construction in Step 1.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof.text: For $f:j\to j'$, the map $W_j\to W_{j'}$ sends $t:u(a)\to j$ to $f\circ t$. Therefore the contravariant action defining $RQ$ in Step 1 sends $RQ(j')\to RQ(j)$ by precomposition with precisely $u^*h_j\to u^*h_{j'}$. Identities and composition follow from those in the discrete weight and coherent Hom precomposition. The equivalences in Steps 2-5 are natural in all their inputs, giving the claimed coherent dependence on $P,Q,j$. If $A$ is empty, both mapping spaces reduce to a point and $RQ$ is terminal; if $J$ is empty then $A$ is empty and all assertions hold in terminal functor categories. The end formulas allow empty shapes and values, so no extra nonemptiness assumption was used.

source.place: Corollary 6.3.10, pp.291-292; explicit agent end/Yoneda proof of its ordinary-nerve specialization.

proof_origin.place: Corollary 6.3.10; explicit coherent-end and natural Yoneda argument, using Kerodon 03P7.
